title: senecio doria subsp. biebersteinii
intro: Senecio doria subsp. biebersteinii, commonly known as the Giant Ragwort, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in managing conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio doria subsp. biebersteinii are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a purgative, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, along with other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids.
